concept.literalSynthesis: A vampire-spark wand woven into the identity of a stitched vampire costume, combining the wand and the sewn vampire garment as one wearable magical implement.
concept.coreMechanic: Use the magic wand to fire one red ember that follows a gravity arc and restores a small amount of life when it actually hits an NPC. The same item can be equipped as an accessory for defense, life regeneration, and a modest movement-speed bonus. The shot retains the wand's 12 damage, 26-tick cadence, and 4-mana cost; its hit-triggered healing is capped at 1 life per hit. Equipment effects apply while equipped, not while merely held.
concept.parentAContribution: The vampire-spark wand identity supplies the central magic ember attack, its magic damage and cadence, and the useful on-hit life siphon. The authored ember explicitly uses gravity and hit-triggered healing.
concept.parentBContribution: The stitched vampire costume identity turns the wand into a wearable accessory. Its useful life regeneration and movement benefit join a small explicit defense bonus; these are equipped effects, not benefits from holding the item.
concept.playerExperience: A measured magic shot preserves the wand's original damage, cadence, and mana price while its ember arc makes hits require a little aim adjustment. Each actual hit restores at most 1 life. Equipping the item grants +2 defense, +1 HP/s life regeneration, and +5% movement speed; those bonuses do not apply while the wand is only held.

plannedPlayerActions.intent: Fire one gravity-arc magic ember toward the cursor; a real hit restores up to 1 life. Each use costs 4 mana and follows the 26-tick reuse cadence.
Wear the wand as an accessory for +2 defense, +1 HP/s life regeneration, and +5% movement speed.

realization.description: Use the Vampire-Spark Stitchwand to fire a single red magic ember toward the cursor. The ember travels at an authored initial speed of 26.25 blocks/s, curves downward under gravity, and expires after 1.5 seconds if it has not hit a tile or NPC. It deals 12 base magic damage and restores 10% of dealt damage on a real hit, up to 1 life per hit. Each use costs 4 mana and has a 0.433-second reuse interval. Equip the wand as an accessory to gain 2 defense, 1 HP/s life regeneration, and 5% movement speed; these bonuses apply only while equipped.
realization.playerExperience: The shot keeps the source wand's single-projectile cadence and mana cost; the gravity arc rewards aiming a little above distant targets. The accessory's modest defense, regeneration, and movement bonuses are available only in an equipment slot.
realization.selfEvaluation: The projectile explicitly owns its gravity movement, damage, collision, lifetime, and hit healing. The accessory effects are attached to the equipped input and are not attributed to holding the item.
